Make use of the following modals in sentence as asked in brackets. 09   
(i) Can. (To express a polite request)   
(ii) Can. (To express an offer to somebody else)   
(iii) Could. (To express a past ability)   
(iv) Would rather. (To express a preference)   
(v) Had better. (To express a duty at present)   
(vi) Should. (To express propriety)
